_comment: What the tools need to know about one game (see tools/game.py). 'assetContext' is relative to games/<game>/. 'cdnSources': dead CDN host -> host that serves the same files (tools/make-aria2.py). 'port': where the server inside the app listens (each game its own, so several can be installed). 'hiddenTables': tables behind menus that are hidden offline; images only they use aren't downloaded or shipped (tools/make-aria2.py). 'newsBannerColors': background gradient of the lobby news banner (tools/news_banner.py).
